_about: 黄金现货 2026-09-30 收盘是否高于 2026-06-30 收盘的冻结证据包。信息截至 2026-06-30 收盘；LBMA 官方日价表需付费授权，本包使用公开行情站报价并在 resolution 中说明。

evidence.title: Gold Price June 30 2026
evidence.excerpt: On June 2026 30, gold closed at $4,007.52 per troy ounce (24K), or $128.8/g.
evidence.claim: 截点日现货黄金收盘价为 4007.52 美元/盎司，是比较基准。（次级来源，非 LBMA 官方日价。）

evidence.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
evidence.excerpt: The Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent, in support of the Federal Reserve's dual mandate.
evidence.claim: 截点前的 FOMC 维持利率不变，实际利率环境是当时金价走向的主要不确定性。
